runs.prompt: Comedian Shane Gillis is facing backlash over a joke he made in his Saturday Night Live monologue involving women at the gym. runs.answer: On the Oct. 10, 2026 episode of Saturday Night Live, host Shane Gillis said in his monologue: "I haven't been to the gym in so long, I didn't know women just dress like whores now? Look, I'm sorry, there's no other way to describe it. Have you seen it? The shorts. Have you seen the shorts? Those neon, they're like artificial bait-colored. Reactions: Dan Levy called it out, saying "Women wearing short shorts at the gym does not make them whores.
